# hetzner-mcp

> An enterprise-grade Model Context Protocol server for the full Hetzner platform. It lets an
> AI assistant manage Hetzner Cloud (servers, networks, volumes, firewalls, load balancers,
> IPs, DNS), Storage Boxes, and Robot dedicated servers, with a hard cost guard, a destructive
> guard, secret redaction, SSRF-safe requests, and token-efficient responses. There is no
> official Hetzner MCP. This is a tested, community-built one.

## What it does
- Three surfaces from one server. Cloud (api.hetzner.cloud), Storage Box (api.hetzner.com),
  Robot dedicated servers (robot-ws.your-server.de). DNS is part of the Cloud API.
- 32 tools. 3 generic per-surface request tools for complete coverage, 28 curated read tools,
  1 contribution tool.
- Safety first. billed resources are never created without an explicit confirm and a live
  price preview. DELETE requires confirm. A read-only mode refuses all writes.

## Key docs
- Setup and credentials, beginner friendly with screenshots: docs/SETUP.md
- Security model and threat list: docs/SECURITY.md
- Validating audit, every endpoint tested live: docs/AUDIT.md
- Multi-auditor quality comparison: docs/AUDITORS.md
- Token budget and efficiency: docs/TOKEN-BUDGET.md
- Endpoint inventory and changelog: docs/ENDPOINT-AUDIT.md
- Contributing: CONTRIBUTING.md

## Install
- claude mcp add hetzner -e HETZNER_CLOUD_TOKEN=your-token -- npx -y hetzner-mcp
